title: Office-Visit Component Settled Under the Payer's Office-Visit Benefit — Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Rate schedule note — Insured Plan of Care.** The payer settles an office-visit component of certain visits under its office-visit benefit. In reviewing a coinsurance charge, that office-visit component is also taken out before the coinsurance percentage is applied:

| Kind of reviewed visit | Office-visit component taken out |
|---|---|
| Re-evaluation or progress report visit | The fixed re-evaluation component of **$45.00** |
| Initial evaluation visit | The visit's whole allowed amount |
| Any other visit (treatment, telehealth treatment) | Nothing ($0.00) |

The component is subtracted, together with any other amount taken out before the coinsurance percentage is applied, from the amount the percentage is applied to; the remainder is never taken below zero, and the percentage then acts once on that remainder.

**Footnotes to the schedule (hypothetical visits, coinsurance percentage 20%).**

1. A progress report visit allowed at $125.00: $45.00 is taken out, leaving $80.00; the coinsurance share on it is $16.00.
2. A re-evaluation allowed at $40.00: taking out $45.00 would go below zero, so the remainder is $0.00 and the share is $0.00.
3. An initial evaluation allowed at $180.00: the whole $180.00 is taken out, leaving $0.00; no coinsurance share is supported for that visit.
4. A treatment visit allowed at $110.00: nothing is taken out for the office-visit component.
